slots.ev: 晚間新聞收播，棚裡其他燈都關了，只剩主播桌上那一盞
slots.pl: 台南地方台的新聞棚，收播後，棚內其他燈已經關了
slots.pl_en: at the news desk of a local Tainan station after the broadcast has ended, every other light in the studio already switched off
slots.ac: 她還坐在主播桌後面，手上拿著剛剛那疊稿子，人已經鬆下來
slots.ac_en: She is still behind the desk with the script she has just read in her hand, already gone slack in the chair.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：下播後西裝外套一定先掛好，其他的才隨便（外套還在椅背上）
slots.of: 主播西裝外套已經脫在椅背，白襯衫只扣了兩顆
slots.of_en: her suit jacket already off over the back of the chair, her white shirt buttoned only twice
slots.of_s: 私下核心：襯衫只扣兩顆／標誌性配額是「私下改造版」，這一格不是
slots.li: 主播桌上方那一盞燈還亮著，棚內其餘部分全黑
slots.li_en: The one light above the desk is still on and the rest of the studio is completely black.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「乾淨、對稱感強的棚內」——但收播後只剩一盞，對稱被打破
slots.fa: 播報的臉已經卸掉了，看向棚的另一邊
slots.fa_en: The broadcast face is already off, and she is looking over to the other side of the studio.
slots.fa_s: 幽默：用播報腔講很日常的事
slots.hair_en: still set for broadcast, the wine-red section showing at one side

slots.ev: 回到老公寓，第一件事是把西裝外套掛好，然後才去拿梳妝台第一格的挑染片
slots.pl: 台南老公寓的梳妝台前，第一格抽屜是開著的
slots.pl_en: at the dressing table in her old Tainan apartment, the first drawer pulled open
slots.ac: 她把酒紅色的挑染片夾上去，動作很熟
slots.ac_en: She is clipping the wine-red hair piece in, her hands doing it without needing to look.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：私下才夾的酒紅挑染片放在梳妝台第一格
slots.of: 白襯衫還穿著，黑絲和高跟鞋都沒換
slots.of_en: still in the white shirt, still in black stockings and heels she has not changed out of
slots.of_s: 私下核心：襯衫只扣兩顆、黑絲、高跟鞋留著沒換
slots.li: 梳妝台的檯燈是唯一的光，從她側前方來，房間其餘部分全暗
slots.li_en: The dressing-table lamp is the only light, reaching her from the side and in front, the rest of the room completely dark.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「私下場景刻意破壞構圖，用單一光源與陰影」
slots.fa: 眼睛往下看著手上的髮片，嘴角有一點
slots.fa_en: Her eyes are down on the hair piece in her hand and there is something at the corner of her mouth.
slots.fa_s: 私下核心：她享受這個只有自己知道的落差
slots.hair_en: dark brown, the wine-red section being clipped in at one side

slots.ev: 白天翻那一整櫃只在鏡頭前穿的衣服，找下一集要穿的
slots.pl: 老公寓的衣櫃前，整櫃都是只在鏡頭前穿的衣服
slots.pl_en: in front of the open wardrobe in her old apartment, a whole rail of clothes she only ever wears on camera
slots.ac: 她把一件外套拉出來看肩線，另一手還扶著衣櫃門
slots.ac_en: She has pulled one jacket out to check how the shoulder sits, her other hand still on the wardrobe door.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：家裡有一整櫃只在鏡頭前穿的衣服
slots.of_en: an off-white long house skirt with a fitted top
slots.li: 白天的窗光從側面進來，衣櫃內側暗
slots.li_en: Daylight comes in from the side and it stays dark inside the wardrobe.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「私下場景刻意破壞構圖」——白天也不用對稱構圖
slots.fa: 很專業地在評估一件衣服
slots.fa_s: 性格：她的工作是每天把自己整理成一個可信的樣子
slots.hair_en: down and unstyled, no hair piece in

slots.ev: 睡不著，上頂樓吹風，洗衣繩上還晾著東西
slots.pl: 老公寓的頂樓，夜裡，一條洗衣繩還橫在那裡
slots.pl_en: up on the roof of her old apartment building at night, a washing line still strung across it
slots.ac: 她靠在女兒牆上，讓風把襯衫吹起來一點
slots.ac_en: She is leaning back against the parapet, letting the wind lift the shirt a little.
slots.ac_s: 私下核心原句：頂樓夜風
slots.of: 墨綠色長版襯衫外套，裡面是貼身的
slots.of_en: a dark green long shirt worn open over something fitted
slots.li: 城市的燈在她身後比較亮，頂樓本身沒有光源
slots.li_en: The city glow behind her is the brighter thing; the roof itself has no light of its own.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「棚內的紀律感 vs 老公寓的鬆散」
slots.fa_en: Emptied out, looking off into the distance.
slots.fa_s: 語氣：私下的貼文反而很短
slots.hair_en: down and moving in the wind, the wine-red section visible

slots.ev: 出差到別的城市，白天有兩個小時是自己的
slots.pl: 出差那個城市的舊城河堤，白天，對岸是低矮的老房子，堤上這一段沒有別人
slots.pl_en: on the old riverside embankment of the city she is working in, low old houses on the far bank, this stretch of it empty
slots.ac: 她靠在堤邊的欄杆上，一手拿著飲料，看著對岸
slots.ac_en: She is leaning on the rail at the edge of the embankment with a drink in one hand, looking across to the far bank.
slots.ac_s: 性格：帳號是她想有一個地方可以不用字正腔圓
slots.of: 暖木色系的長洋裝配平底鞋
slots.of_en: a long dress in warm wood tones with flat shoes
slots.li: 太陽在對岸那一側，光從她背後過來，河面反著亮
slots.li_en: The sun is over on the far bank so the light comes from behind her, and the river surface is the brightest thing in the frame.
slots.li_s: 後製：私下場景用單一光源——這一格是外出，所以不套用
slots.fa: 很鬆的表情，完全不是播報的臉，眼睛看著對岸
slots.fa_en: A very loose expression, nothing like the broadcast face, her eyes on the far bank.
slots.fa_s: 誰是她：落差本身就是最有力的內容
